messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: Re: R square calculation in R/QTL
parts:
> I was wondering do we have any function in R/QTL to calculate the R square for single marker-phenotype relation and also R square for two QTL-phenotype? I looked at tutorials but couldn't find the topic.

You can use fitqtl. It's marked as "%var" in the summary. The %var assigned to individual QTL are not trustworthy in the case of linked QTL.

Example code:

data(hyper)
hyper <- sim.geno(hyper, n.draws=128)
qtl <- makeqtl(hyper, chr=c(1, 4), pos=c(49.2, 29.5))
summary(out.1qtl <- fitqtl(hyper, qtl=qtl, formula=y~Q2))
summary(out.2qtl <- fitqtl(hyper, qtl=qtl, formula=y~Q1+Q2))

karl
